mapper.select: SELECT d.DISPOSAL_ID, d.DISPOSAL_NO, d.DISPOSAL_TYPE, d.ASSET_ID, d.ORIGINAL_VALUE, d.NET_VALUE, d.DISPOSAL_INCOME, d.DISPOSAL_PROFIT_LOSS, d.DISPOSAL_DATE, d.REASON, d.STATUS, d.REMARK, d.TENANT_ID, d.CREATE_BY, d.CREATE_TIME, d.UPDATE_BY, d.UPDATE_TIME, d.IS_DELETED, a.ASSET_CODE AS assetCode, a.ASSET_NAME AS assetName, a.ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION AS accumulatedDepreciation FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_DISPOSAL d LEFT JOIN TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CARD a ON d.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID AND a.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.DISPOSAL_ID = #{disposalId} AND d.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FIXED_ASSET_DISPOSAL SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE DISPOSAL_ID = #{disposalId}
